source: AAOS normal range of motion (Greene & Heckman 1994)
label: Range-of-motion demonstration from AAOS normal limits (educational simulation, not measured motion)

movements.name: shoulder flexion
movements.note: 120 of AAOS 180: glenohumeral share by the 2:1 scapulohumeral rhythm (Inman et al. 1944); no scapulothoracic joint yet

movements.name: shoulder abduction
movements.note: 90 of AAOS 180: no scapulothoracic joint yet

movements.name: forearm pronation
movements.note: AAOS 80+80 from supinated rest; radius rotates about the ulna (radial head to ulnar head axis)
